title: Paris musicians: Byas, Leadbelly and Big Bill
summary: He saw Don Byas, Bill Coleman, Leadbelly and Big Bill Broonzy in Paris.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: I see. Let's who else -- Was it Byas?

Yes, Don Byas was at a place called the Rinkside and Bill Coleman was around, too. Also I saw an advertisement, friend of mine, Huddie Ledbetter better known as Leadbelly and he was making an appearance at the University of Paris. And I went to the concert, well received, beautiful man, old man but he's still sharp. He's got a good voice and he was singing while he was there.
Did Paris audiences like the kind of blues singing that he did and his folk songs.

Yes. Another fella around there was Big Bill Bronz y, and in later years I heard of Mezzrow taking Zutty Singleton coming around there, tour of the country. He drew a big crowd, this Zutty was a great --
